name: W. P. Carey Inc.
sector: Real Estate / REIT — Net lease (single-tenant industrial, warehouse, retail)
moat_justification: Durable contractual cash flows (12.2y WALT, escalators on ~99% of leases, 98.5% occupancy, 384 tenants) plus an investment-grade cost-of-capital and sourcing advantage — but net lease is commodity capital with no pricing power past market cap rates, thin cap-rate-over-funding spreads, and growth bought with dilutive external capital. Moderate/narrow moat, 5/10. ROIC evidence: fundamentals.json produces no roic_proxy for WPC (no operating-income series filed in its extraction) and its ~99% 'gross margin' is a rental-accounting artifact, so the score rests on the contractual/structural evidence above, consistent with peer REIT scores (KIM 5, EXR 5, CCI 6, VICI 7).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Real Estate sector — OE/capex DCF fits real estate names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11, accession 0001025378-26-000036), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Funding for real estate construction, redevelopments, and other capital expenditures on real estate': $191,213 thousand for FY2025, $135,327 thousand for FY2024 and $121,625 thousand for FY2023); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 8.3x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (8.2%) vs bull-case tier C (13.4%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Contractual net-lease cash machine (12.2y WALT, 98.5% occupancy), moat 5/10 — but at $65.14 it does not clear 15%: weighted IRR 11.2%, weighted IV@15% $44.43 vs the $65.14 price; it clears the 15% hurdle only below ~$44. Sector-misfit REIT model, confidence low.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: sector model misfit; tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Contractual duration: 12.2-year weighted-average lease term, 98.5% occupancy, ~99% of leases with escalators (48% CPI-linked, 49% fixed) — 2.6% contractual same-store rent growth
Diversification: 1,748 properties, 384 tenants, top-10 tenants only 18.1% of ABR, US + Europe, industrial/warehouse/retail mix
Cost-of-capital advantage: investment-grade BBB+/Baa1 unsecured access, 3.2% weighted-average debt rate, $2.7B liquidity, forward-equity ATM machine
Sale-leaseback sourcing franchise built since 1973 — proprietary deal flow in operationally-critical single-tenant assets
moat_against: Net lease is commodity capital: no pricing power beyond market cap rates at origination/renewal
Growth is externally funded — ATM forward equity and unsecured debt issuance dilute (share count +3.3%/yr)
Thin spread economics: returns are the cap-rate/interest-rate spread, so a higher-for-longer rate regime compresses the model
Tenant credit events recur (Hellweg insolvency 2026, Q2 2026 impairments of $79.4M); single-tenant assets are binary on default
REIT payout (~73% of AFFO) retains little; nothing compounds internally

overrides.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-11, accession 0001025378-26-000036), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Funding for real estate construction, redevelopments, and other capital expenditures on real estate': $191,213 thousand for FY2025, $135,327 thousand for FY2024 and $121,625 thousand for FY2023
